Image generation requesting multiple images

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateImageRequest;
use Liter\Llm\Image;
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->imageGenerate(new \Liter\Llm\CreateImageRequest(prompt: "A red bicycle",
model: "dall-e-2",
n: 3,
size: "256x256"));
var_dump($result->getData());
var_dump($result->getData()[0]->url);
```
